title: Quantifying the Privacy-Utility Trade-offs in COVID-19 Contact Tracing Apps
reasoning: The paper's central theme is the analysis of the ethical trade-off between public health utility and the right to individual privacy in the context of COVID-19 contact tracing applications. It systematically evaluates different apps based on this 'privacy-utility trade-off', which is a fundamental ethical consideration in public health technology, making ethics a core component of the research rather than a brief mention.
